blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **устра́ивать** — to arrange, to organize, to establish. Wiktionary: устро́ить + -ивать.
**рассма́тривать** — to look at, to peruse, to examine. Wiktionary: рассмотре́ть + -ивать.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to arrange, to organize, to establish
to look at, to peruse, to examine
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ука́зывать — to show, to indicate; дока́зывать — to prove, to demonstrate; устра́ивать — to arrange, to organize, to establish; рассма́тривать — to look at, to peruse, to examine.
**свя́зывать** — to tie together, to bind. Wiktionary: связа́ть + -ывать.
**вздра́гивать** — to start, to startle, to flinch, to wince. Wiktionary: вздро́гнуть + -ивать.
**остана́вливать** — to stop, to bring to stop. Wiktionary: останови́ть + -ивать.
**запи́сывать** — to write down, to enter (to set something down in writing). Wiktionary: записа́ть + -ывать.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to start, to startle, to flinch, to wince
to stop, to bring to stop
to write down, to enter (to set something down in writing)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: свя́зывать — to tie together, to bind; вздра́гивать — to start, to startle, to flinch, to wince; остана́вливать — to stop, to bring to stop; запи́сывать — to write down, to enter (to set something down in writing).
**выслу́шивать** — to hear out, to listen (to the end). Wiktionary: вы́слушать + -ивать.
**обма́нывать** — to deceive, to cheat, to trick, to swindle. Wiktionary: обману́ть + -ывать.
**вспы́хивать** — to flash (to briefly illuminate a scene). Wiktionary: вспы́хнуть + -ивать.
**подхва́тывать** — to catch (up), to pick up, to grasp, to snatch. Wiktionary: подхвати́ть + -ывать.
